description: Finds the official reference page for exact WordPress names: functions, hooks, classes, methods, WP-CLI commands, REST routes, core blocks and @wordpress packages. Use before writing or reviewing code that calls one, to confirm it exists in WordPress core, since which version, and whether it is deprecated. Pass up to 8 names in one call. Returns links with a one-line summary, never the page content; a name that is not in WordPress core is reported as not found. For a guide or a plugin's documentation, use wp_docs.

names.description: Exact names, separated by commas: "get_theme_mod, save_post, WP_Query::get_posts, wp plugin list, /wp/v2/posts, core/paragraph"

name: wp_code
title: WordPress code reference
